units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 12b:18">B. Mets. 12ᵇ</cite> <he>בשח׳ מודה</he> when the debtor admits (that the note has not been paid); a. fr.
<cite ref="Mishnah Peah 4:7">Peah IV, 7</cite> <he>ח׳</he> he is bound (to leave the poor man’s corner).
<cite ref="Ketubot 30b:3">Keth. 30ᵇ</cite> <he>ולרבא ח׳</he> and according to Raba’s opinion he must pay; a. v. fr.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 1:1">Sabb. I, 1</cite> <he>ח׳</he> is guilty (of Sabbath-breaking, eventually bound to bring a guilt-offering); a. v. fr.—Pl. <he>חַיָּיבִין</he>.
Ber. III, 1 ח׳ are bound (to read the Sh’ma); a. fr.—Fem. חַיֶּיבֶת.
<cite ref="Chagigah 4a:5">Ḥag. 4ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>שהאשה ח׳ בה</he> which woman is bound to observe; a. fr.—Pl. <he>חַיָּיבוֹת</he>.

senses.gloss: wicked.—Fem. as ab. Mekh. B’shall. s. 1 מלכות ח׳ wicked government (usu. רְשָׁעָה).
